# hosttracker_contact_types (Data Source)

The contact-type catalogue: what each channel is called, whether it can be created through the API at all, whether it needs confirming, and which alert delays it accepts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The catalogue says which channels can be created through the API at all,
# which of them need confirming, and which alert delays each one accepts -
# a contact's `alert_delay` must be one of those, or the write is refused.
data "hosttracker_contact_types" "all" {}

output "email_alert_delays" {
  value = one([for t in data.hosttracker_contact_types.all.types : t.alert_delays if t.type == "email"])
}

output "creatable_types" {
  value = [for t in data.hosttracker_contact_types.all.types : t.type if t.creatable]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `types` (Attributes List) One row per contact type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `alert_delays` (List of Number) The alert delays this type accepts, in minutes. A contact's `alert_delay` must be one of them.
- `confirmable` (Boolean) Whether a contact of this type must confirm a code before it receives anything.
- `creatable` (Boolean) Whether a contact of this type can be created through the API. A messenger channel is not: the recipient registers with the bot instead.
- `gateways` (List of String) The delivery gateways this type can be routed through.
- `label` (String) The human name.
- `requires_registration` (Boolean) Whether the recipient must register with a messenger before delivery works.
- `supports_reports` (Boolean) Whether scheduled reports can be delivered to this type.
- `template_parameters` (Attributes List) The `[[token]]` vocabulary a custom message body may use. On the `http` row only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types--template_parameters))
- `type` (String) The type token, as `type` on a contact takes it.

<a id="nestedatt--types--template_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types.template_parameters`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the renderer substitutes for it.
- `events` (List of String) The alert types the token resolves on; the others render it blank.
- `name` (String) The token's name, written `[[name]]` in a body.
